notes:
User enjoys experimenting with specialty coffee, especially French press, and is exploring citrus-infused coffee. Their current preferred French press ratio is 1 tablespoon of coffee per 5 ounces of water. They favor bright, vibrant flavors; Kenyan coffee was their first citrus-pairing option. They also like Earl Grey for its bergamot/citrus character.

They signed up for a coffee subscription service last month and received their first shipment yesterday. They are excited to brew the new beans and experiment with citrus notes. Storage guidance previously included keeping beans airtight in a cool, dark place, grinding just before brewing, using opened beans within about two weeks, or freezing airtight portions longer term.

The user is also developing an interest in tea. They want relaxing teas similar to chamomile and are considering Adagio Teas and The Tea Spot subscriptions. They plan to organize a tea cabinet and were advised to store tea airtight and dark, in a cool dry place away from heat, moisture, odors, and sunlight; smaller quantities may reduce exposure. They may check current first-order/subscription promotions, as previously mentioned codes and offers may change. Specific tea type/subscription and budget/frequency remain unspecified.

They asked how to clean a French press thoroughly, especially to remove old coffee oils. Advice included disassembling it, washing with hot soapy water, scrubbing gently, rinsing well, and drying thoroughly; avoid abrasives and harsh dishwasher use.

Recently, their sister introduced them to rose tea. They plan to try it and asked whether it pairs with sweet treats; shortbread cookies were suggested as a good match because their buttery sweetness complements the floral notes. Other possible pairings included fruit, vanilla or lemon cake, and white or rose-infused chocolate. The service, bean origin/roast, and tea subscription details remain unknown.
